w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🔥 The fire settles. Daniyar has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then t

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: Siege. Hold the chokepoint for three waves while the village watches from the walls. The line holds, or you don't."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/5/5), with 6 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 10 · Craft 7 · Talk 9 · Explore 29 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Mara Vasquez ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
